23268-the-scalp-hunters.title: The Scalp Hunters
23268-the-scalp-hunters.creator: Unknown
23268-the-scalp-hunters.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. I stand in an open plain. I turn my face to the north, to the south, to the east, and to the west; and on all sides behold the blue circle of the heavens girdling around me. Nor rock, nor tree, breaks the ring of the horizon. What covers the broad expanse between? As far as my eye can range, it rests only on flowers, on beautiful flowers!

arxiv-2206-13506.title: Tensor Recovery Based on A Novel Non-convex Function Minimax Logarithmic Concave Penalty Function
arxiv-2206-13506.creator: Hongbing Zhang, Xinyi Liu, Chang Liu, Hongtao Fan, Yajing Li, Xinyun Zhu
arxiv-2206-13506.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hongbing Zhang, Xinyi Liu, Chang Liu, Hongtao Fan, Yajing Li, Xinyun Zhu. Non-convex relaxation methods have been widely used in tensor recovery problems, and compared with convex relaxation methods, can achieve better recovery results. In this paper, a new non-convex function, Minimax Logarithmic Concave Penalty (MLCP) function, is proposed, and some of its intrinsic properties are analyzed, among which it is interesting to find that the Logarithmic function is an upper bound of the MLCP function.

arxiv-2207-06084.title: Towards A Holistic View of Bias in Machine Learning: Bridging Algorithmic Fairness and Imbalanced Learning Journal: Machine Learning
arxiv-2207-06084.creator: Damien A. Dablain, Bartosz Krawczyk, Nitesh V. Chawla
arxiv-2207-06084.description: Abstract Machine learning (ML) is playing an increasingly important role in rendering decisions that affect a broad range of groups in society. ML models inform decisions in criminal justice, the extension of credit in banking, and the hiring practices of corporations.

arxiv-2303-05031.title: CoralStyleCLIP: Co-optimized Region and Layer Selection for Image Editing
arxiv-2303-05031.creator: Ambareesh RevanurDebraj BasuShradha AgrawalDhwanit AgarwalDeepak PaiAdobe Inc
arxiv-2303-05031.description: Abstract Edit fidelity is a significant issue in open-world controllable generative image editing. Recently, CLIP-based approaches have traded off simplicity to alleviate these problems by introducing spatial attention in a handpicked layer of a StyleGAN. In this paper, we propose CoralStyleCLIP, which incorporates a multi-layer attention-guided blending strategy in the feature space of StyleGAN2 for obtaining high-fidelity edits.

arxiv-2401-05294.title: Enhanced Muscle and Fat Segmentation for CT-Based Body Composition Analysis: A Comparative Study
arxiv-2401-05294.creator: Benjamin Hou, Tejas Sudharshan Mathai, Jianfei Liu, Christopher Parnell, Ronald M. Summers
arxiv-2401-05294.description: Abstract Purpose: Body composition measurements from routine abdominal CT can yield personalized risk assessments for asymptomatic and diseased patients. In particular, attenuation and volume measures of muscle and fat are associated with important clinical outcomes, such as cardiovascular events, fractures, and death.

arxiv-2402-02227.title: Invisible Finger: Practical Electromagnetic Interference Attack on Touchscreen-based Electronic Devices
arxiv-2402-02227.creator: Haoqi Shan 1 § , Boyi Zhang 1 § , Zihao Zhan 1 , Dean Sullivan 2 , Shuo Wang 1 , Yier Jin 1
arxiv-2402-02227.description: Abstract Touchscreen-based electronic devices such as smart phones and smart tablets are widely used in our daily life. While the security of electronic devices have been heavily investigated recently, the resilience of touchscreens against various attacks has yet to be thoroughly investigated.

arxiv-2404-15809.title: Dark matter and space-time symmetry restoration
arxiv-2404-15809.creator: João Magueijo
arxiv-2404-15809.description: Abstract We examine local physics in the presence of global variables: variables associated with the whole of the spacelike surfaces of a foliation. These could be the (pseudo-)constants of nature and their conjugate times, but our statements are more general.

arxiv-2405-18160.title: Sampling metastable systems using collective variables and Jarzynski–Crooks paths
arxiv-2405-18160.creator: C. Schönle, M. Gabrié, T. Lelièvre, G. Stoltz
arxiv-2405-18160.description: Abstract We consider the problem of sampling a high dimensional multimodal target probability measure. We assume that a good proposal kernel to move only a subset of the degrees of freedoms (also known as collective variables) is known a priori. This proposal kernel can for example be built using normalizing flows [ NOKW19 , LW18 , GRV22 ] .

arxiv-2411-16640.title: Optimal control problems on the co-adjoint Lie groupoids
arxiv-2411-16640.creator: Ghorbanali Haghighatdoost
arxiv-2411-16640.description: Abstract In this work we study the invariant optimal control problem on Lie groupoids. We show that any invariant optimal control problem on a Lie groupoid reduces to its co-adjoint Lie algebroid. In the final section of the paper, we present an illustrative example. Keywords 1 Optimal control problem, Invariant control system, Hamiltonian system, Co-adjoint Lie groupoid.

arxiv-2412-19343.title: Nanofiber-based second-order atomic Bragg lattice for collectively enhanced coupling
arxiv-2412-19343.creator: N. Vera, P. Solano
arxiv-2412-19343.description: Abstract We propose two experimental schemes for nanofiber-based compensated optical dipole traps that optimize the collective coupling of a one-dimensional array of atoms. The created array satisfies the second-order Bragg condition ( d = λ d=\lambda ), facilitating constructive interference of atomic radiation into the nanofiber and generating coherent back reflections of guided modes.

arxiv-2503-07215.title: The CodeInverter Suite: Structure- and Data-Aware Binary Decompilation with Efficient LLMs
arxiv-2503-07215.creator: Peipei Liu, Jian Sun, Rongkang Sun, Li Chen, Zhaoteng Yan, Xiaoling Zhang, Dawei Wang, Dapeng Sun, Peizheng Zhang, Dan Li
arxiv-2503-07215.description: Abstract . Binary decompilation plays a vital role in various cybersecurity and software engineering tasks. Recently, end-to-end decompilation methods powered by large language models (LLMs) have attracted increasing attention for their ability to generate highly readable source code with minimal human intervention.

arxiv-2503-10237.title: Efficient Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Noisy Inverse Problems Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2503-10237.creator: Ji Li, Chao Wang
arxiv-2503-10237.description: Abstract The pretrained diffusion model as a strong prior has been leveraged to address inverse problems in a zero-shot manner without task-specific retraining. Different from the unconditional generation, the measurement-guided generation requires estimating the expectation of clean image given the current image and the measurement.

arxiv-2504-12221.title: Phonon-Coupled Hole-Spin Qubits in High-Purity Germanium: Design and Modeling of a Scalable Architecture
arxiv-2504-12221.creator: D.-M. Mei, S. A. Panamaldeniya, K. Dong, S. Bhattarai, N. Budhathoki, A. Warren
arxiv-2504-12221.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by D.-M. Mei, S. A. Panamaldeniya, K. Dong, S. Bhattarai, N. Budhathoki, A. Warren. We present a design and modeling of a scalable quantum processor architecture utilizing hole-spin qubits defined in gate-controlled germanium (Ge) quantum dots, where coherent spin-phonon coupling is predicted to facilitate qubit manipulation and long-range interactions. The architecture exploits the strong, electrically tunable spin-orbit interactions intrinsic to hole states in Ge, integrated with high-quality phononic crystal cavities (PnCCs) to enable fully electrical qubit control and phonon-mediated coupling.

arxiv-2506-04440.title: The Age and High Energy Environment of the Very Young Transiting Exoplanet TOI 1227b
arxiv-2506-04440.creator: Attila Varga, Joel H. Kastner, Alexander S. Binks, Hans Moritz Guenther, Simon J. Murphy
arxiv-2506-04440.description: Abstract The mid-M star TOI 1227 hosts among the youngest known transiting exoplanets. We have conducted new X-ray imaging and optical spectroscopic observations of TOI 1227 aimed at ascertaining its age and the influence of its high-energy radiation on the exoplanet, TOI 1227b.

arxiv-2507-02371.title: Time- and Polarization-Resolved Extreme Ultraviolet Momentum Microscopy
arxiv-2507-02371.creator: Sotirios Fragkos, Quentin Courtade, Olena Tkach, Jérôme Gaudin, Dominique Descamps, Guillaume Barrette, Stéphane Petit, Gerd Schönhense, Yann Mairesse, Samuel Beaulieu
arxiv-2507-02371.description: Abstract We report the development of an instrument combining an ultrafast, high-repetition-rate, polarization-tunable monochromatic extreme ultraviolet (XUV, 21.6 eV) beamline and a next-generation momentum microscope endstation. This setup enables time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy of quantum materials, offering multimodal photoemission dichroism capabilities. The momentum microscope simultaneously detects the full surface Brillouin zone over an extended binding energy range.

arxiv-2507-15821.title: Just Put a Human in the Loop? Investigating LLM-Assisted Annotation for Subjective Tasks
arxiv-2507-15821.creator: Hope Schroeder, Deb Roy, Jad Kabbara
arxiv-2507-15821.description: Abstract LLM use in annotation is becoming widespread, and given LLMs’ overall promising performance and speed, simply "reviewing" LLM annotations in interpretive tasks can be tempting. In subjective annotation tasks with multiple plausible answers, reviewing LLM outputs can change the label distribution, impacting both the evaluation of LLM performance, and analysis using these labels in a social science task downstream.

arxiv-2508-02897.title: Fibrations of handlebodies
arxiv-2508-02897.creator: Jesús Hernández Hernández, Christopher J. Leininger, Ferrán Valdez
arxiv-2508-02897.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jesús Hernández Hernández, Christopher J. Leininger, Ferrán Valdez. We show that the open genus 2 handlebody admits uncountably-many fibrations over the circle with fiber homeomorphic to the Cantor tree surface with non-conjugate monodromies in the mapping class group. The construction generalizes to produce uncountably many fibrations of other tame 3 3 –manifolds with infinite type fibers, including the blooming Cantor tree and many other types of surfaces. arxiv-2602-23839.title: Spin effects in the tau-lepton pair induced by anomalous magnetic and electric dipole moments Thanks: Presented at the XLVI International Conference of Theoretical Physics “Matter to the Deepest”, Katowice, Poland, 15-19 September, 2025.
arxiv-2602-23839.creator: A. Yu. Korchin
arxiv-2602-23839.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by A. Yu. Korchin. The possible anomalous New Physics contributions to magnetic and electric dipole moments of the τ \tau lepton have brought renewed interest in studying τ \tau -pair production at energies of the LHC and future colliders.

columbus-journal-first-voyage-1493.title: Journal of the First Voyage of Christopher Columbus
columbus-journal-first-voyage-1493.creator: Christopher Columbus
columbus-journal-first-voyage-1493.description: Columbus's 1493 mermaid sighting off the Rio del Oro — 'they were not as beautiful as they are said to be' — in Clements Markham's 1893 Hakluyt Society translation of the Las Casas abstract.

gao-gaoreports-gao-06-605t.description: Small Business Administration: Improvements Made, but Loan Programs Face Ongoing Management Challenges (2006).

goethe-faust-hayward-1833.creator: J. W. von Goethe (Abraham Hayward, trans.)
goethe-faust-hayward-1833.description: Hayward's 1833 first complete English Faust in prose — the translation that introduced Faust to English readers. Full text, public domain.

pmc-10518892.title: Revisiting Peter Macklem's old dream through the PRISm of lung volumes
pmc-10518892.creator: Engi Ahmed, Zakaria Mohamed Lahmar, Arnaud Bourdin
pmc-10518892.description: Tweetable abstractIn the 1960s, Peter Macklem and, later, Sonia Buist shared the vision of a marker to identify smokers who will progress to COPD based on small airway function assessment [1–3]. While this discussion has continued, the unmet need of prediction remains the same.

pmc-10665754.title: The potential role of miRNA in regulating macrophage polarization
pmc-10665754.creator: Shaho Khayati, Sajad Dehnavi, Mahvash Sadeghi, Jalil Tavakol Afshari, Seyed-Alireza Esmaeili, Mojgan Mohammadi
pmc-10665754.description: Macrophage polarization is a dynamic process determining the outcome of various physiological and pathological situations through inducing pro-inflammatory responses or resolving inflammation via exerting anti-inflammatory effects. The miRNAs are epigenetic regulators of different biologic pathways that target transcription factors and signaling molecules to promote macrophage phenotype transition and regulate immune responses.

pmc-11648611.title: Non-Gaussian diffusive fluctuations in Dirac fluids
pmc-11648611.creator: Sarang Gopalakrishnan, Ewan McCulloch, Romain Vasseur
pmc-11648611.description: SignificanceDynamical universality, the principle that microscopically diverse systems display the same hydrodynamic behavior and universal scaling laws, is a central concept in nonequilibrium physics. For mean transport, this principle is embodied by dynamical exponents. Whether universal scaling laws also apply to fluctuations remains an important open question.

pmc-12534302.title: Privacy preservation in blockchain-based healthcare data sharing: A systematic review
pmc-12534302.creator: Kun Li, Ankur Lohachab, Michel Dumontier, Visara Urovi
pmc-12534302.description: Blockchain technology promises enhanced data ownership, control, and interoperability in healthcare, yet security and privacy concerns continue to hinder its adoption. Existing surveys examine blockchain-based privacy challenges, but they lack a systematic analysis and maturity evaluation of privacy-preserving techniques tailored to healthcare data sharing.

pmc-12653353.title: Long-Term Reproductive Outcomes After Palmer-Type Neosalpingostomy in Hydrosalpinx: A Seven-Year Real-World Cohort Study
pmc-12653353.creator: Laurențiu Augustus Barbu, Nicolae-Dragoș Mărgăritescu, Liliana Cercelaru, Tiberiu Stefăniță Țenea Cojan, Mădălina Costinela Stănică, Irina Enăchescu, Ana-Maria Țenea Cojan, Valentina Căluianu, Gabriel Florin Răzvan Mogoș, Liviu Vasile
pmc-12653353.description: Background: Hydrosalpinx is a major cause of female infertility, but the long-term outcomes of Palmer-type neosalpingostomy remain insufficiently documented. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed 160 women with primary or secondary infertility and laparoscopically confirmed hydrosalpinx who underwent Palmer-type neosalpingostomy at a single specialized center in Romania (2018–2024). Patients were enrolled consecutively, and disease severity was classified intraoperatively using standardized criteria.

pmc-12984240.title: TensorCSBP: A Tensor Center-Symmetric Feature Extractor for EEG Odor Detection
pmc-12984240.creator: Irem Tasci, Ilknur Sercek, Yunus Talu, Prabal Datta Barua, Mehmet Baygin, Burak Tasci, Sengul Dogan, Turker Tuncer
pmc-12984240.description: Objective: Accurate odor classification from EEG signals requires informative and interpretable features. Although Local Binary Pattern (LBP) and variants such as the center-symmetric binary pattern are widely used, they lack sufficient explainability and tensor-level implementations. Additionally, neuroscientific understanding of odor processing remains limited.

pmc-13087135.title: Efficacy of vaginal 17β-estradiol on the urinary storage symptoms in postmenopausal women: a randomized double-blind, placebo-controlled study
pmc-13087135.creator: Pornthip Harncharoenkul, Rujira Wattanayingcharoenchai, Pisut Pongchaikul, Komkrit Aimjirakul, Orawee Chinthakanan, Jittima Manonai
pmc-13087135.description: This randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluated the efficacy of vaginal 17β-estradiol (10 mcg) in alleviating storage symptoms of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) in postmenopausal women. A total of 86 participants were randomized to receive either vaginal 17β-estradiol or placebo for 12 weeks, with both groups undergoing standardized behavioral modifications.

pmc-13417471.creator: Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine

pmc-13439080.title: Social dynamics of AI adoption in parents’ educational decisions
pmc-13439080.creator: Leonardo Bursztyn, Alex Imas, Rafael Jiménez-Durán, Aaron Leonard, Christopher Roth
pmc-13439080.description: SignificanceOur study shows that competitive social pressures, rather than cost–benefit analyses, can increase the diffusion of new technologies before their long-term costs are fully understood. We study this in the context of the unrestricted use of new AI tools for teenagers in education.

pmc-13526249.title: Iron Content and Nutritional Quality of Commercial Complementary Baby Foods Available in Australia
pmc-13526249.creator: Ghazal Akbaridoust, Talicia Sutherland, Jimmy Chun Yu Louie, Roxana Valdés-Ramos
pmc-13526249.description: BackgroundOptimal nutrition in infancy supports growth, development and long‐term health. Commercial complementary foods are widely used in Australia, yet concerns persist regarding their iron, sugar and sodium content. This study examines their nutritional composition.MethodsIn 2024, nutrition information was collected for complementary foods labelled from 6 months of age across four major retailers in Melbourne.
